communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Oklahoma Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

an export of public records concerning municipal water utility accounts that have experienced service disruptions due to non-payment or fire.
Specifically, I am requesting an electronic data export (preferably in CSV, Excel, or structured text format) of all residential and commercial water utility accounts that meet any of the following criteria within the past 120 days:
1. Accounts that have been physically disconnected or shut off for non-payment or fire.
2. Accounts where the meter has been locked out or pulled due to delinquency or fire.
3. Accounts currently on the final "scheduled for disconnect" or delinquency termination list.
To the extent available within your utility management system, please ensure the exported data fields include:
• Full Service Address (Street Number, Street Name, Unit, City, Zip Code)
• Disconnect, Lockout, or Shut-off Date
• Current Status Code / Account Status (e.g., Closed, Disconnected, Pending Shut-off)
Please note that I am not requesting individual customer payment histories, bank details, or Social Security numbers. If your department considers the outstanding dollar balance or individual customer names to be confidential or exempt under privacy guidelines, please redact only those specific fields and provide the rest of the structural location and status data.
As an electronic database export is requested, please provide these records in their native electronic format to avoid unnecessary printing or scanning fees.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

AJ Keys

communications.subject: Oklahoma Open Records Act Request: 2026 Structure Fires
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Oklahoma Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Oklahoma Open Records Act, I request public records concerning residential structure fires within the City of Norman.

Specifically, I request a digital spreadsheet, report, or incident log identifying all residential properties where the Norman Fire Department responded to a structure fire from January 1, 2026, through the date this request is processed.

To limit clerical search time, please provide the information in its existing electronic format, such as Excel, CSV, or a text file. Please include the following available fields:

- Property owner’s or responsible party’s name
- Property address
- Date of the fire
- Incident type
- Description or estimated extent of property damage

I am requesting a summary list or incident log rather than complete individual incident reports, photographs, medical information, 911 recordings, or investigative files.

If the Fire Department does not maintain the property owner’s name or any other field requested please provide the remaining requested fields available. If no centralized spreadsheet or log exists, please provide the existing underlying electronic records from which this information can be extracted.

If the estimated cost will exceed $25, please provide an itemized estimate before processing the request.

If any portion of this request is denied, withheld, or redacted, please identify the specific statutory exemption under the Oklahoma Open Records Act and release all reasonably segregable portions of the record

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Sincerely,

AJ Keys

title: Municipal Government AI Policies, Procedures and Cost

communications.subject: Connecticut Freedom of Information Act Request: Municipal Government AI Policies, Procedures and Cost
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Connecticut Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Dear Freedom of Information Officer:
Under the Connecticut Freedom of Information Act, Conn. Gen. Stat. § 1-200 et seq., including § 1-210(a), I request copies of the public records described below held by the Town of Stamford, including its departments, boards, commissions, and offices.
In this request, "AI tools" means Microsoft Copilot (including Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, Copilot Studio, and GitHub Copilot), Google Gemini (including Gemini for Google Workspace and Gemini accessed through Google Cloud or Vertex AI), and Anthropic's Claude (including Claude.ai team or enterprise plans and the Claude API). This includes tools bought directly, through a reseller, under an enterprise or cooperative purchasing agreement, or bundled into another license.

1. Contracts and costs. All contracts, license or subscription agreements, terms of service accepted on the Town's behalf, quotes, purchase orders, invoices, amendments, renewals, and payment records for any AI tool. Also any budget line items, appropriations, or approvals by the Board of Selectmen, Town Council, Board of Finance, or similar body that relate to these purchases.
2. Number of accounts and licenses. Records showing the number of licenses or seats purchased and the number of active user accounts for each AI tool, broken out by department where such records exist. This includes license-assignment reports or exports from the Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, or Anthropic administrative consoles.
3. Token usage and usage-based cost. Records showing token consumption, API call volume, credits used, or other usage metrics for each AI tool, and the resulting usage-based charges. This includes monthly or periodic usage reports, billing statements, and billing-dashboard exports.
4. Policy on internal use. Any policy, guideline, memo, administrative directive, acceptable-use standard, procedure, or training material governing employees' use of AI tools for internal work, such as drafting documents, analyzing data, writing code, or summarizing meetings. Please include drafts under active consideration and records of their approval or adoption.
5. Policy on communication with residents. Any policy, guideline, memo, or procedure governing the use of AI tools in communications with residents or the public. This includes letters, emails, website or social media content, chatbots, responses to public inquiries, and any requirement to disclose or review AI-generated content.
6. Documented corrections on AI use. Records documenting instances in which an employee was counseled, warned, corrected, retrained, or disciplined about the use of AI tools. This includes emails, memos, incident or IT security reports, and notices of policy violations. I recognize that some of this material may fall under § 1-210(b)(2); I ask that the Town redact names and personally identifying details rather than withhold whole records, and that it provide any existing aggregate counts or summaries of such instances.

Time frame. Records dated from January 1, 2025 through the date the Town conducts its search.

I also request that, if possible and pursuant to Conn. Gen. Stat. § 1-212(d), fees be waived as I believe this request is in the public interest and not made for commercial gain. The requested documents will be made available to the public at MuckRock.com.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 4 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

B Skalling

title: Psychological Strategy Board drafts of PSB D-31 (1952)

communications.subject: Freedom of Information Act Request: Psychological Strategy Board drafts of PSB D-31 (1952)
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I request copies of the drafts of PSB D-31, "A Strategic Concept for a National Psychological Program with Particular Reference to Cold War Operations under NSC 10/5" (final November 26, 1952), in Record Group 59, S/S-NSC Files, Lot 62 D 333, and in the Psychological Strategy Board files, including the mid-1952 draft titled "A Strategic Concept for Cold War Operations under NSC 10/5" (PSB control no. 63783) and the draft circulated August 20, 1952, with any program annexes.
